markets.title: Oil hits $100 for first time since July
markets.raw_summary: Brent crude advances as escalation in US-Iran war feeds fears of renewed global supply crunch

insight.what: 布伦特原油价格突破每桶100美元，为去年7月以来首次，因美伊冲突升级引发供应中断担忧。
insight.why: 市场此前已计入部分地缘风险溢价，但100美元关口被突破意味着供给冲击预期从'尾部风险'变为'基准情景'，全球通胀预期和央行政策路径需重新定价。
insight.chain: 美伊军事冲突升级 → 伊朗原油出口受阻预期增强 → 全球原油供给缺口预期扩大 → 布伦特油价突破100美元 → 能源通胀预期上行 → 各国央行降息空间收窄 → 债券收益率承压上行 → 股市估值压力增加
notes: 布伦特原油是全球约三分之二原油贸易的定价基准，其价格变动直接影响各国进口成本。
油价上涨会直接推高汽油、柴油等成品油价格，进而传导至运输、化工等各行各业的生产成本，最终体现为消费者物价上涨。
央行加息或维持高利率以对抗通胀，会使无风险利率（即国债收益率）保持在较高水平，进而提高企业和个人的融资成本，抑制经济活动。
对于股票等风险资产而言，利率上升意味着未来现金流折算到现在的价值下降，尤其是依赖远期增长的成长型公司受冲击更大。
美伊冲突若导致霍尔木兹海峡（全球约五分之一石油运输的必经之路）受阻，油价可能进一步跳升。

insight_en.what: Brent crude prices broke above $100 per barrel for the first time since July last year, as the escalation of the U.S.–Iran conflict sparked concerns over supply disruptions.
insight_en.why: The market had already priced in part of the geopolitical risk premium, but the breach of the $100 threshold means that expectations of a supply shock have shifted from a 'tail risk' to the 'base case,' requiring global inflation expectations and central bank policy paths to be repriced.
insight_en.chain: Escalation of the U.S.–Iran military conflict → Stronger expectations of disruptions to Iranian crude exports → Expected global crude supply shortfall widens → Brent crude prices break above $100 → Energy inflation expectations rise → Central banks have less room to cut rates → Upward pressure on bond yields → Increased pressure on equity valuations
notes: Brent crude is the pricing benchmark for around two-thirds of global crude oil trade, and changes in its price directly affect countries' import costs.

Rising oil prices directly push up the prices of refined petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel, with the increases then transmitted to production costs across industries such as transportation and chemicals, ultimately resulting in higher consumer prices.

Central banks raising interest rates or keeping them high to combat inflation will keep risk-free rates (i.e., government bond yields) elevated, thereby increasing financing costs for businesses and individuals and restraining economic activity.
For risk assets such as equities, higher interest rates mean a lower present value of future cash flows, with growth companies that depend on longer-term growth hit particularly hard.
If the U.S.–Iran conflict disrupts the Strait of Hormuz, through which around one-fifth of global oil shipments must pass, oil prices could jump further.

markets.title: ‘I am the house now’: Bessent warns currency traders not to bet against yen
markets.raw_summary: Comments follow July’s rare joint intervention with Tokyo to support Japanese currency

insight.what: 美国财政部长贝森特警告投机者不要做空日元，称'我就是市场'，此前美日曾联合干预汇市支撑日元。
insight.why: 这改变了市场对日元单边贬值路径的预期，暗示官方对当前汇率水平有明确底线，做空日元的交易面临政策性干预风险，日元及日本资产波动率将上升。
insight.chain: 美方警告做空日元 → 投机性空头回补 → 日元需求增加 → 日元汇率升值 → 日本出口企业盈利预期下调 → 日经指数承压 → 套息交易平仓加速 → 全球风险资产波动加剧
notes: 做空日元指投资者借入日元后卖出，预期未来能以更低价格买回获利，这押注的是日元贬值。
套息交易是指借入低利率货币（如日元）投资于高收益资产，赚取利差。当日元突然升值时，这类交易会亏损，平仓行为会进一步推升日元。
联合干预是指多国央行或财政部协同在外汇市场买卖货币，以影响汇率走势，这通常被视为强力信号。
日本出口企业盈利与日元汇率高度负相关，日元升值会降低其海外收入换算回日元的价值。
贝森特'我就是市场'的表态，意在强调官方拥有无限资源，足以对抗任何规模的投机力量。

insight_en.what: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent warned speculators against shorting the yen, saying 'I am the market,' following earlier joint U.S.–Japanese intervention in the FX market to support the yen.
insight_en.why: This changes market expectations of a one-way depreciation path for the yen, suggesting that the authorities have a clear bottom line regarding current exchange-rate levels; short yen trades face policy intervention risk, and volatility in the yen and Japanese assets will rise.
insight_en.chain: U.S. warning against shorting the yen → Speculative short covering → Increased demand for yen → Yen appreciation → Downward revisions to Japanese exporters' earnings expectations → Pressure on the Nikkei index → Accelerated unwinding of carry trades → Increased volatility in global risk assets
notes: Shorting the yen means investors borrow yen and sell it, expecting to profit by buying it back at a lower price in the future; this is a bet on yen depreciation.

A carry trade involves borrowing a low-interest-rate currency, such as the yen, to invest in higher-yielding assets and earn the interest-rate differential. When the yen suddenly appreciates, these trades incur losses, and unwinding the positions pushes the yen even higher.

Joint intervention refers to coordinated purchases and sales of currencies in the FX market by central banks or finance ministries from multiple countries to influence exchange-rate movements; this is usually viewed as a strong signal.
Japanese exporters' earnings are highly negatively correlated with the yen's exchange rate, as yen appreciation reduces the value of their overseas revenue when converted back into yen.
Bessent's statement, 'I am the market,' is intended to emphasize that the authorities have unlimited resources sufficient to counter speculative forces of any size.

markets.title: 美国2年期国债收益率上行2个基点至4.42%，创2025年1月以来新高。

insight.what: 美国2年期国债收益率上行2个基点至4.42%，创2025年1月以来新高。
insight.why: 收益率创新高表明市场正在重新定价美联储的降息预期，很可能因为近期通胀数据反弹或官员鹰派言论，短端利率预期升温直接冲击所有依赖低利率的资产。
insight.chain: 通胀数据反弹 → 市场下调降息预期 → 2年期美债收益率上行 → 无风险利率抬升 → 高估值成长股承压 → 科技板块回调 → 美元指数走强 → 新兴市场资本外流压力增加
notes: 2年期国债收益率对利率政策最敏感，它反映的是市场对未来两年内央行基准利率的平均预期。
收益率上行意味着债券价格下跌，二者呈反向变动关系。
无风险利率是全球资产定价的锚，它上升时，所有未来现金流的折现值都会下降，资产价格普遍承压。
美元走强会使得以美元计价的资产对海外投资者更贵，同时增加新兴市场国家的偿债成本，引发资本流出。
基点（bps）是利率变动的最小单位，1个基点等于0.01%。

insight_en.what: The U.S. 2-year Treasury yield rose 2 basis points to 4.42%, its highest level since January 2025.
insight_en.why: The new high in yields indicates that the market is repricing expectations for Fed rate cuts, most likely because of a rebound in recent inflation data or hawkish comments from officials; rising expectations for short-term interest rates directly hit all assets that depend on low interest rates.
insight_en.chain: Rebound in inflation data → Market scales back rate-cut expectations → U.S. 2-year Treasury yield rises → Risk-free rate increases → Pressure on highly valued growth stocks → Pullback in the technology sector → U.S. Dollar Index strengthens → Increased capital outflow pressure on emerging markets
notes: The 2-year Treasury yield is the most sensitive to interest-rate policy, reflecting the market's expectation of the average central bank benchmark rate over the next two years.
Rising yields mean falling bond prices; the two move inversely.
The risk-free rate is the anchor for global asset pricing; when it rises, the discounted value of all future cash flows declines, putting broad pressure on asset prices.
A stronger dollar makes dollar-denominated assets more expensive for overseas investors while increasing debt-servicing costs for emerging-market countries, triggering capital outflows.
Basis points (bps) are the smallest unit of interest-rate changes; 1 basis point equals 0.01%.

markets.title: Bitcoin heads for third winning week in a row as macro pressures mount
markets.raw_summary: Bitcoin headed for its third straight winning week, as traders searched for refuge amid volatile moves in equities, currencies and bond markets.

insight.what: 比特币连续第三周上涨，交易员在市场波动中寻求避险资产。
insight.why: 比特币上涨与股市、债市、汇市剧烈波动形成对比，市场可能将其视为对冲地缘风险和货币政策不确定性的工具，这改变了部分资金的风险配置方向。
insight.chain: 地缘政治风险加剧 → 传统资产波动加剧 → 部分资金寻求非主权资产 → 比特币需求增加 → 比特币价格上涨 → 数字资产相关板块吸引资金流入 → 与传统市场的相关性下降
notes: 非主权资产是指不依托任何国家政府信用背书的资产，比特币是其中最典型的代表，被部分投资者视为规避单一国家风险的工具。
避险资产通常指在市场动荡时能保值或增值的资产，如黄金、美元等。比特币是否具备这一属性存在争议，但在特定环境下确实吸收了部分避险需求。
比特币总量上限为2100万个，其供应稀缺性被类比为'数字黄金'。
连续上涨可能吸引趋势跟踪型资金入场，进一步推高价格，形成正反馈循环。

insight_en.what: Bitcoin rose for a third consecutive week as traders sought safe-haven assets amid market volatility.
insight_en.why: Bitcoin's gains contrast with sharp volatility in equity, bond and FX markets; the market may view it as a tool for hedging geopolitical risks and monetary policy uncertainty, changing how some capital is allocated across risks.
insight_en.chain: Heightened geopolitical risk → Increased volatility in traditional assets → Some capital seeks non-sovereign assets → Increased demand for Bitcoin → Bitcoin prices rise → Digital asset-related sectors attract capital inflows → Lower correlation with traditional markets
notes: Non-sovereign assets are assets that do not rely on the credit backing of any national government; Bitcoin is the most typical example and is viewed by some investors as a tool for avoiding risks specific to a single country.

Safe-haven assets generally refer to assets that can preserve or increase their value during market turmoil, such as gold and the U.S. dollar. Whether Bitcoin has this characteristic is disputed, but it has indeed absorbed some safe-haven demand under certain conditions.
Bitcoin's total supply is capped at 21 million, and its scarcity of supply draws comparisons with 'digital gold'.
Consecutive gains may attract trend-following capital, pushing prices higher and creating a positive feedback loop.

policy.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
policy.raw_summary: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

insight.what: 美英对也门胡塞武装及伊朗目标发动新一轮空袭后，布伦特原油价格升至每桶100美元上方。
insight.why: 红海和霍尔木兹海峡是全球能源运输大动脉，军事行动升级直接威胁供给，市场对油价持续高企的预期强化，这会加大全球通胀压力并压缩央行政策空间。
insight.chain: 美英空袭胡塞武装与伊朗目标 → 红海及霍尔木兹海峡航运风险上升 → 原油运输保险费跳涨 → 部分油轮绕道好望角 → 有效原油供给减少 → 油价突破100美元 → 全球能源成本上升 → 通胀预期抬升
notes: 胡塞武装控制也门部分沿海地区，其袭击商船的行为直接威胁红海航线。
红海是通过苏伊士运河连接地中海与印度洋的捷径，绕道好望角将增加约一周航程和大量燃油成本。
油轮运输保险费上涨会直接增加原油到岸成本，即使原油本身离岸价不变。
有效供给不只是产量，还包括能及时运达市场的量，绕行导致运输周转率下降。
市场对通胀预期的变化会传导至长期国债收益率，影响房贷利率、企业融资成本等实体经济变量。

insight_en.what: Brent crude prices rose above $100 per barrel after the U.S. and U.K. launched a new round of airstrikes against Yemen's Houthi forces and Iranian targets.
insight_en.why: The Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz are major arteries for global energy transportation; escalating military action directly threatens supply, reinforcing market expectations that oil prices will remain elevated, which will intensify global inflationary pressure and constrain central banks' policy space.
insight_en.chain: U.S. and U.K. airstrikes against Houthi forces and Iranian targets → Shipping risks rise in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz → Crude oil shipping insurance premiums jump → Some oil tankers reroute around the Cape of Good Hope → Effective crude supply declines → Oil prices break above $100 → Global energy costs rise → Inflation expectations increase
notes: Houthi forces control parts of Yemen's coastal areas, and their attacks on merchant vessels directly threaten the Red Sea shipping route.
The Red Sea is a shortcut connecting the Mediterranean Sea and the Indian Ocean via the Suez Canal; rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope adds around a week to the voyage and substantial fuel costs.
Higher tanker shipping insurance premiums directly increase the landed cost of crude oil, even if its free-on-board price remains unchanged.
Effective supply includes not just production but also the volume that can reach the market in time; detours reduce shipping turnover rates.
Changes in market inflation expectations are transmitted to long-term government bond yields, affecting real-economy variables such as mortgage rates and corporate financing costs.

policy.title: U.S. military says it destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers after attacks on Navy warship
policy.raw_summary: The U.S. military said it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday in response to the latest attacks on its warships. Iran hit American targets in Jordan.

insight.what: 美国军方宣布在伊朗袭击美海军战舰后，摧毁了5艘伊朗油轮作为回应。
insight.why: 直接摧毁油轮是对伊朗石油出口能力的实体打击，远超经济制裁的隔靴搔痒，市场定价的是伊朗原油断供的可能性及规模，这在边际上大幅推高油价。
insight.chain: 伊朗袭击美舰 → 美国击毁伊朗油轮 → 伊朗石油出口能力受损 → 全球重质原油供应缺口扩大 → 布伦特油价飙升 → 能源板块远期盈利能力大增 → 通胀预期螺旋上升
notes: 伊朗是石油输出国组织重要成员，其日均出口量约150万桶，摧毁油轮直接减少了可用的运力。
重质原油是伊朗主要出口油品，被用于生产柴油和燃料油，其供给短缺难以被轻质原油快速替代。
石油供应缺口的预期一旦形成，会吸引投机性买盘，进一步放大价格波动。
能源板块盈利预期上升会推动其股价上涨，但与整体股市形成跷跷板效应。
此事件与单纯的经济制裁不同，它表明冲突已从金融领域扩展到实体打击，风险溢价更高。

insight_en.what: The U.S. military announced that it had destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers in response to Iran's attack on U.S. Navy warships.
insight_en.why: Directly destroying oil tankers is a physical blow to Iran's oil export capacity, far more forceful than the ineffectual impact of economic sanctions; the market is pricing in the probability and scale of a cutoff in Iranian crude supplies, sharply pushing oil prices higher at the margin.
insight_en.chain: Iran attacks U.S. warships → U.S. destroys Iranian oil tankers → Iran's oil export capacity is damaged → Global heavy crude supply shortfall widens → Brent crude prices surge → Energy sector's future profitability increases sharply → Inflation expectations spiral upward
notes: Iran is a major member of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, with average daily exports of around 1.5 million barrels; destroying tankers directly reduces available shipping capacity.
Heavy crude is Iran's main oil export and is used to produce diesel and fuel oil; a shortage in its supply cannot easily be made up quickly with light crude.
Once expectations of an oil supply shortfall form, they will attract speculative buying, further amplifying price volatility.
Higher earnings expectations for the energy sector will push up its share prices, but create a seesaw effect with the broader stock market.
This event differs from purely economic sanctions: it indicates that the conflict has expanded from the financial sphere to physical strikes, carrying a higher risk premium.

policy.title: South Korea supercharges defense budget to record levels
policy.raw_summary: South Korea's record defense budget comes amid disparaging comments about Seoul's alliance with the United States by its president, Donald Trump.

insight.what: 韩国将国防预算提升至创纪录水平，以应对朝鲜威胁及盟友关系的不确定性。
insight.why: 东北亚地缘紧张局势加剧，国防开支增加意味着财政赤字可能扩大，这会影响韩国的国债发行规模和主权信用评估，同时军工产业链获得确定性订单。
insight.chain: 地缘局势紧张 → 韩国提高国防预算 → 财政支出增加 → 国债发行量上升 → 韩国国债收益率上行 → 韩元汇率承压 → 军工企业订单激增 → 相关股票及供应链受益
notes: 国防预算通常通过发行国债融资，供给增加会压低债券价格、抬高收益率。
韩元汇率与本国资产收益率和资本流动密切相关，收益率上升在短期内可能吸引外资流入，但长期若由财政恶化驱动，则会削弱币值信心。
军工产业具有长周期、高确定性的订单特点，预算增加直接改善其未来现金流预期。
韩国作为美国盟友，其防务自主意识的提升反映在全球供应链的'安全优先'趋势上，影响跨国企业的区域布局决策。

insight_en.what: South Korea has raised its defense budget to a record high to address threats from North Korea and uncertainty in relations with its allies.
insight_en.why: Geopolitical tensions in Northeast Asia are escalating, and increased defense spending means the fiscal deficit could widen, affecting the scale of South Korean government bond issuance and sovereign credit assessments, while the defense industry supply chain receives firm orders.
insight_en.chain: Geopolitical tensions → South Korea increases its defense budget → Fiscal spending rises → Government bond issuance increases → South Korean government bond yields rise → Pressure on the won's exchange rate → Defense companies' orders surge → Related stocks and supply chains benefit
notes: Defense budgets are usually financed through government bond issuance; increased supply depresses bond prices and raises yields.

The won's exchange rate is closely linked to domestic asset yields and capital flows; rising yields may attract foreign capital inflows in the short term, but if driven by fiscal deterioration over the long term, they will undermine confidence in the currency's value.
The defense industry is characterized by long-cycle orders with a high degree of certainty; budget increases directly improve expectations for its future cash flows.

The growing emphasis on defense autonomy in South Korea, a U.S. ally, is reflected in the 'security first' trend in global supply chains, affecting multinational companies' decisions on their regional footprints.

policy.title: Houthi offensive on Bab el-Mandeb Strait threatens new Red Sea shipping crisis
policy.raw_summary: A battle for control of Yemen’s coastal plains overlooking the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait, launched on Friday by Iran-aligned Houthi rebels, is rapidly intensifying into an all-out war with Saudi-

insight.what: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装对曼德海峡发动进攻，威胁引发新一轮红海航运危机。
insight.why: 曼德海峡是连接红海与亚丁湾的咽喉要道，全球约10%的贸易海运量从此经过，军事冲突升级将直接抬高亚洲至欧洲的货轮运输成本和安全风险溢价。
insight.chain: 胡塞武装进攻曼德海峡 → 商船通航风险骤增 → 航运公司宣布停航或改道 → 亚欧航线运力紧张 → 运费指数暴涨 → 进口商品成本上升 → 输入型通胀压力加大 → 欧亚央行政策收紧预期升温
notes: 曼德海峡最窄处仅约26公里，是全球最繁忙的能源和货物运输通道之一。
部分保险公司已宣布对经过该区域的船只想提高战争险保费，这是运价攀升的直接催化。
航运成本上升会以滞后的方式传导至零售价格，推升消费者物价指数。
欧洲和亚洲的大型经济体高度依赖此航道，相关影响对它们的冲击远大于美国。
这一事件与第21条关于美加贸易战的内容共同构成了全球供应链摩擦的两大主线。

insight_en.what: Iran-backed Houthi forces have launched an attack on the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, threatening to trigger a fresh Red Sea shipping crisis.
insight_en.why: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait is a key chokepoint linking the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, through which around 10% of global seaborne trade volume passes; escalating military conflict will directly increase freight shipping costs from Asia to Europe and the security risk premium.
insight_en.chain: Houthis attack the Bab el-Mandeb Strait → Risks to merchant vessel transit surge → Shipping companies announce suspensions or rerouting → Shipping capacity tightens on Asia–Europe routes → Freight rate index surges → Cost of imported goods rises → Imported inflation pressure intensifies → Expectations of monetary tightening by European and Asian central banks increase
notes: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait is only about 26 kilometers wide at its narrowest point and is one of the world's busiest corridors for transporting energy and goods.
Some insurers have already announced that they intend to raise war-risk insurance premiums for vessels passing through the area, a direct catalyst for rising freight rates.
Higher shipping costs will be transmitted to retail prices with a lag, pushing up the consumer price index.
The major economies of Europe and Asia are highly dependent on this shipping route, and the impact on them is far greater than on the U.S.
This event and the discussion of the U.S.–Canada trade war in item 21 together form the two main strands of global supply chain friction.
